facts.value: void(UnkFloat6_Camera* in, UnkFloat6_Camera* out, float mul). in supplies the x0 and xC components, out receives the corresponding scaled components, and mul is the common float multiplier. The declaration does not qualify in as const.
facts.rationale: Keep exact source signature and input/output roles; shared-layout size and dimensionless model-scale claims require family type review.

facts.value: Unconditionally activates the existing CmSubject. Only facing_dir == 1.0f selects subject facing +1; every other value selects -1 and mirrored horizontal target extents. It copies both horizontal and vertical target extents into current extents and copies pos into bone_pos. Unlike ftCamera_UpdateCameraBox, this initializer does not clear on_ledge or call ftLib_800866DC; the update does not perform this activation or extent synchronization.

evidence.why: Activation, facing branches, extents and positions copied into paired fields.
Update leaves activation and current extents untouched and refreshes bone position through a separate helper.

facts.rationale: Preserve exact facing branch and make initialization versus named update writes explicit.

facts.value: Executes six component assignments in source order with no branches or scalar validation. Exact in-place use with in == out scales each component once because each assignment reads and writes only that component. A nonoverlapping output leaves the input unchanged; partial overlapping objects are not asserted safe.

evidence.why: Each assignment reads the corresponding input component before storing its scaled output.

facts.rationale: Records aliasing and scalar behavior visible in the complete body without assuming camera-specific bounds on mul.
